name: Yuna, Grand Summoner
oracle_text:
Grand Summon — {T}: Add one mana of any color. When you next cast a creature spell this turn, that creature enters with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.
Whenever another permanent you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, if it had one or more counters on it, you may put that number of +1/+1 counters on target creature.
blocked_sentences: Grand Summon — {T}: Add one mana of any color. When you next cast a creature spell this turn, that creature enters with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.

needs.what: a mana-ability rider that sets up a delayed trigger on activation (no stack): 'when you next cast a creature spell this turn' (fires once, then expires at end of turn), whose effect makes THAT spell's permanent enter with N additional +1/+1 counters (a replacement on the spell, not counters added after it enters)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: A mana ability may hold only add_mana plus riders from add_counters/add_poison/damage/gain_life/lose_life/remove_counters, so delayed_trigger cannot ride on it; mana_grant hands over keywords only, never counters; enters_with_additional_counters is a standing static over a filter rather than a one-shot tied to the next creature spell cast this turn; and add_counters on a spell_cast delayed trigger would act on the spell on the stack, not make the permanent enter with them
